title: Common-degree twists are invertible on a quasi-compact Proj open
statement: Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ be a nonnegatively graded commutative ring, $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$ [def-pc-proj], and let $U\subseteq P$ be a quasi-compact open subscheme [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] [def-weil-open-immersion]. Suppose homogeneous elements $f_1,\ldots,f_r$ of positive degrees cover $U$ by $U\subseteq\bigcup_iD_+(f_i)$. If $e\geq1$ is a common multiple of their degrees, let $W_e$ be the largest open subscheme of $P$ on which every $\mathcal O_P(ne)$ is invertible and all multiplication maps $\mathcal O_P(ne)\otimes\mathcal O_P(me)\to\mathcal O_P((n+m)e)$ are isomorphisms (equivalently, the union of standard opens $D_+(ab)$ with homogeneous $a,b$ and $\deg(a)=\deg(b)+e$). Then $U\subseteq W_e$; consequently, for every $k\geq1$, the restricted twist $\mathcal O_U(ek)=\mathcal O_P(ek)|_U$ is invertible [def-sc-invertible-module], and the canonical multiplication map $\mathcal O_U(e)^{\otimes k}\to\mathcal O_U(ek)$ is an isomorphism [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product].

source.place: Tag 01MW (lemma-ample-on-proj), proof after the finite standard-open cover: clauses (1)--(4), using Tag 01MS (lemma-where-invertible).

proof.text: Use the cover already supplied in the hypotheses. For each i put g_i=f_i^(e/d_i). Divisibility gives degree e and e>0 gives e/d_i>0; basicOpen_pow identifies D_+(g_i) with D_+(f_i). Thus every point of V lies in a standard open of a degree-e element. No finite-subcover or basis theorem is needed here.
For each degree-e homogeneous a, choose beta=0 and b=1 in the given union formula for W. This puts D_+(a) inside W. The degree-e cover therefore proves V <= W.

On any open contained in D_+(a), construct the section a^n of O(ne) as the homogeneous fraction a^(n.toNat)/a^((-n).toNat). The difference of these nonnegative exponents is n. Localization fraction identities give a^n*a^m=a^(n+m) and a^0=1. The section a^(-n) is its pointwise inverse, so isFreeGenerator_twist_of_mul_eq_one makes it a free generator. Restriction transports the generator to V. Its local trivialization gives invertibility at every point.

Pointwise multiplication of homogeneous fractions is bilinear on sections and commutes with restriction. Apply tensor_bilinear_universal on Proj to construct the unique sheaf morphism with this action on local pure tensors, and transport it to V using the proved restriction-tensor comparison. On a degree-e chart it sends the free generator a^n tensor a^m to a^(n+m), so its map on sections of every smaller open is bijective. Hom.isIso_of_forall_bijective_app implies it is an isomorphism. The integer n=k also proves invertibility of the natural-degree twist O(ek).

Start at k=0 with the restriction-of-unit isomorphism followed by unitIsoTwistZero. Recursively tensor the identity of O(e)|V with the k-fold isomorphism, then compose with the binary multiplication isomorphism. This constructs actual isomorphisms for every k, and hence for k>0. The unit map sends 1 to 1. Naturality of tensorHom on tmulSection and the pure-tensor formula for binary multiplication give the required successor formula.

lean.statement: theorem commonDegreeTwistInvertible (V : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) [CompactSpace V.toScheme] (I : Type v) [Finite I] (f : I → A) (d : I → ℕ) (hf : ∀ i, f i ∈ 𝒜 (d i)) (hd : ∀ i, 0 < d i) (hcover : V ≤ ⨆ i, basicOpen 𝒜 (f i)) (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e) (hdiv : ∀ i, d i ∣ e) (W : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (hW : W = ⨆ (α : ℕ) (β : ℕ) (a : 𝒜 α) (b : 𝒜 β) (_ : α = β + e), basicOpen 𝒜 ((a : A) * (b : A))) : V ≤ W ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, ((twist 𝒜 (n * (e : ℤ))).restrict V.ι).IsInvertible) ∧ (∀ n m : ℤ, ∃ μ : Scheme.Modules.tensorObj ((twist 𝒜 (n * (e : ℤ))).restrict V.ι) ((twist 𝒜 (m * (e : ℤ))).restrict V.ι) ⟶ (twist 𝒜 ((n + m) * (e : ℤ))).restrict V.ι, IsIso μ ∧ ∀ (Q : V.toScheme.Opens) (s : Γ((twist 𝒜 (n * (e : ℤ))).restrict V.ι, Q)) (t : Γ((twist 𝒜 (m * (e : ℤ))).restrict V.ι, Q)) (x : V.ι ''ᵁ Q), (((twist 𝒜 ((n + m) * (e : ℤ))).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom (μ.app Q (Scheme.Modules.tmulSection s t))).val x = ((((twist 𝒜 (n * (e : ℤ))).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom s).val x : Localization.AtPrime x.val.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) * (((twist 𝒜 (m * (e : ℤ))).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom t).val x) ∧ (∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → ((twist 𝒜 (Int.ofNat (e * k))).restrict V.ι).IsInvertible) ∧ (∃ μ : ∀ k : ℕ, ((twist 𝒜 (e : ℤ)).restrict V.ι).tensorPow k ⟶ (twist 𝒜 (Int.ofNat (e * k))).restrict V.ι, (∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → IsIso (μ k)) ∧ (∀ (Q : V.toScheme.Opens) (x : V.ι ''ᵁ Q), (((twist 𝒜 (Int.ofNat (e * 0))).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom ((μ 0).app Q (Scheme.Modules.unitSectionsEquiv Q 1))).val x = (1 : Localization.AtPrime x.val.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal)) ∧ (∀ (k : ℕ) (Q : V.toScheme.Opens) (s : Γ((twist 𝒜 (e : ℤ)).restrict V.ι, Q)) (t : Γ(((twist 𝒜 (e : ℤ)).restrict V.ι).tensorPow k, Q)) (x : V.ι ''ᵁ Q), (((twist 𝒜 (Int.ofNat (e * (k + 1)))).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom ((μ (k + 1)).app Q (Scheme.Modules.tmulSection s t))).val x = ((((twist 𝒜 (e : ℤ)).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom s).val x : Localization.AtPrime x.val.asHomogeneousIdeal.toIdeal) * (((twist 𝒜 (Int.ofNat (e * k))).restrictAppIso V.ι Q).hom ((μ k).app Q t)).val x))
